title: Technology stack decision (captured from the user in Phase 1, binding for Phase 2+)

source.description: Stack chosen by the user, or stated in the CRD and confirmed by the user

crd_sources.description: CRD blocks that mention technology constraints

deployment.description: e.g. Docker + docker-compose, Azure App Service, on-prem IIS

authentication.description: e.g. JWT, OAuth2/OIDC with company SSO

architecture_pattern.description: MVC (default): Model-View-Controller with Service and Repository layers, enforced by layer_check. MVT: Django's Model-View-Template. framework-native: the framework's own convention (e.g. Next.js app router, Rails). existing: whatever the imported application already uses. Anything other than MVC needs pattern_rationale.

pattern_rationale.description: Why the pattern is not MVC, and which folder convention the architect must define

forbidden.description: Technologies the specs must not propose (spec rule SV04), e.g. ["jQuery", "Tailwind"]

allowed_mentions.description: Catalog technologies the specs may mention despite not being in the stack (e.g. an external system)

coding_standards.description: Standards that apply, e.g. 'PEP 8 + ruff', 'ESLint airbnb + Prettier', 'knowledge/standards/mvc-coding-standards.md'

constraints.description: Hosting, licensing, browser support, existing systems
